verdicts.reason: A leaves the top third of the canvas empty and crams everything into the lower half. Its list runs items together ('Sore throat Headache', 'Shortness of breath Dry cough'), the call-to-action is tiny and illegible next to an oversized stray sparkle, the #FLATTENTHECURVE bar is shrunk to a thin strip, and the doctor is a small afterthought. B uses the banner shape properly: hashtag bar and headline on the left, list in the middle, doctor with the call-to-action on the right, and one symptom per line. But 'SYMPTOMS' almost touches the list, the list column is cramped with an awkward 'Pain in / chest' break, and the left edges of the hashtag bar and headline don't line up cleanly.
